title: The World's Saltiest Death Trap
topic: Why is the Dead Sea so salty
style: Flat 2D hand-drawn editorial cartoon illustration for a science explainer channel: thick, slightly wobbly black outlines, simple chunky shapes, soft flat colors (pastel greens, warm yellow, light grey, one orange accent), no gradients, no shadows, no textures. Plain off-white background (#FAFAFA). Simple stick-figure people: round head, two dot eyes, thin black stick limbs. Vertical 9:16 composition, main subject large and centered, generous empty space at the top and bottom. No text unless told.
character: Recurring narrator character: a stick figure with a round cream-colored head, big round glasses and a small red cap.

beats.narration: Millions of gallons of freshwater pour into this lake every day, yet zero drops ever leave.
beats.label: 0 OUTLETS
beats.image_prompt: A cutaway landscape of a rushing freshwater river pouring into a landlocked desert canyon lake blocked by sheer mountain walls on all sides.

beats.narration: It sits 430 meters below sea level, making its shores the lowest dry land on Earth.
beats.label: -430 METERS
beats.image_prompt: A stick-figure narrator standing at the bottom of a massive rocky chasm, looking up at a dotted blue sea level line far above.

beats.narration: That is deep enough to bury the Empire State Building underground and still have room above the spire.
beats.label: 1,410 FEET
beats.image_prompt: A cross-section illustration showing the full Empire State Building standing completely submerged beneath a desert ground line.

beats.narration: Because water cannot flow uphill to escape, it is trapped inside a blazing tectonic trench exceeding 40 degrees Celsius.
beats.label: 40°C HEAT
beats.image_prompt: A giant blazing desert sun radiating harsh heat waves over a still, mirror-like lake bordered by cracked dry earth.

beats.narration: Under this relentless heat, pure water evaporates away, abandoning every single grain of mineral it ever carried.
beats.label: EVAPORATION
beats.image_prompt: Thick ghost-like vapor trails rising into the sky from the lake, leaving gleaming white mineral crusts across the shoreline.

beats.narration: Over thousands of years, this brutal evaporation trap produced an extreme salinity of thirty-four percent.
beats.label: 34.2% SALTY
beats.image_prompt: A transparent glass cylinder where the bottom third is packed solid with dense white salt crystals beneath heavy golden brine.

beats.narration: That is nearly ten times saltier than the ocean—like dumping ten tablespoons of salt into one coffee cup.
beats.label: 10x OCEAN
beats.image_prompt: A stick figure dumping an overflowing mountain of salt crystals from a spoon directly into a small ceramic mug.

beats.narration: Underwater, the water is so saturated that salt actively crystallizes, falling through the depths like an underwater blizzard.
beats.label: SALT SNOW
beats.image_prompt: An underwater scene showing sparkling cubic white salt crystals raining downward like heavy snowflakes onto underwater salt pillars.

beats.narration: Modern industry now diverts ninety percent of the Jordan River before it can ever reach the basin.
beats.label: 90% CUT OFF
beats.image_prompt: A massive concrete dam diverting a wide rushing river into pipelines, leaving only a tiny dry trickle heading toward the lake.

beats.narration: Starved of fresh inflow, the Dead Sea's surface is plummeting by 1.2 meters every single year.
beats.label: -1.2 M / YEAR
beats.image_prompt: A tall measuring ruler planted in mud by the receding water, with a red arrow pointing downward past a stick-figure's height.

beats.narration: As the water vanishes, underground freshwater dissolves ancient subterranean salt beds, opening thousands of catastrophic sinkholes along the coast.
beats.label: SINKHOLES
beats.image_prompt: An aerial view of a cracked desert beach pocked with deep, dark, gaping circular craters swallowing the dry shoreline.

beats.narration: The Dead Sea isn't dying from salt—it is evaporating to death. Would you float here before it disappears completely?
beats.image_prompt: A stick-figure floating effortlessly on their back on glassy turquoise water, surrounded by surreal white salt chimneys under an open sky.
